Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to synthesize the conflicting data from the sources it had already accessed (Wikipedia and Britannica) and instead entered a repetitive loop of searching the same queries without attempting to resolve the discrepancy or access the blocked source (The Aerodrome) via alternative methods. Despite the Planner explicitly instructing it to compare numbers, note counting rules, and provide a best-supported figure, the WebSurfer repeatedly returned identical search results showing "44" vs "43" without making progress toward a definitive answer or explaining the difference between the two counts (e.g., one including out-of-control claims). This matches the pattern of "Incomplete or Repetitive Search Execution" and "Circular Decision Flow" where the agent stalls at initial investigative steps without advancing toward resolution.
